comment: Participation is important but he is very chill and is super kind about it. There are readings for every class, but they arent too complicated. He is very kind and funny, I enjoyed his class.

Nice person and knowledgeable about the subject. Didn't enjoy this the most. Three papers in total and a lot of textbook reading. The instructions on the papers are very unclear: usually just one-sentence prompts. There were two journals for the course: coursework and personal . The instructions for journals also unclear. Also too much discussion.

Professor Kitchen is very knowledgeable about the subject matter. He is passionate about climate studies and even wrote the textbook we used for the course. Still, the course is time consuming, three papers, a coursework journal, regular journal, and discussion board post to keep up with. Heavy amount of work if you're a working student.
Hard work, but fascinating and relevant topic. Some lectures too long... not used to long evening classes.
global warming class-he is a very knowledgeable teacher, very nice will work with you on anything you dont understand, you will get a good grade if you follow your class notes.
